# Eight-file diagram fixture

This synthetic model-training workspace tests an overview at the scale of a
real specification change: proposal, design, tasks, and five capability files.
It contains no facts or data from the user's scientific project.

The design explicitly branches into training and reserved evaluation answers,
then joins them for evaluation. Sources explain "persisted split", "fixed
recipe", and "smoke gate" so the reviewed interpretation can replace them with
clear sentences. The undecided error threshold must remain visible.

`examples/diagram-first/model.json` contains the reviewed interpretation.
`content-hashes.json` binds it to the exact fixture bytes. Tests may rebind the
checkout-dependent snapshot only after verifying these hashes.
